redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-authored metadata and non-geographic fixtures only.
Pinned ACT/data.public.lu CACLR and BD-Adresses releases under CC0 with source, release, schema, CRS, byte length, SHA-256 and modifications retained.

sources.terms_note: The official page offers current CSV/XML/PDF files in open access, while the legal notice applies site copyright and no explicit AGID processing, public-serving or redistribution grant was found. Open access is not treated as a reuse licence.

sources.provider: Administration du cadastre et de la topographie
sources.terms_note: CACLR is the official address reference and is CC0. Its file model provides no coordinates, completeness is not guaranteed, and it is not a POST postcode-boundary release.

sources.provider: Administration du cadastre et de la topographie
sources.terms_note: All current features are Point. Coordinates may be manually positioned or calculated from parcel/building centroids; multiple addresses can share coordinates. Completeness is not guaranteed.

artifact_partitions.rule: POST rows retain edition, code class, range semantics, rights and digest; they do not acquire geometry authority.
CACLR rows retain official address-reference identity, code type and release while remaining non-geometric.
BD-Adresses remains Point address context and is never converted to a postcode surface without a separately approved authoritative derivation.
PackUp, Point POST, PO boxes, organizations, routes and special receivers remain non-areal without explicit geometry.
Context geometry remains separate and cannot create or replace postal geometry; building identity needs an explicit source relation.
Recipients, residents, owners, tenants, customers, credentials, private-unit occupants and land-right records never enter public artifacts.
Non-geographic fixtures only; never promotion evidence.
